description: This file defines a React component for job explore filters in a Next.js frontend. It includes several subcomponents for rendering filter UI elements such as dropdowns, multi-select, sliders, and filter chips, along with props interfaces for managing filter state.

methods.name: FieldLabel
methods.description: Renders a label with muted foreground styling.

methods.name: FieldShell
methods.description: A wrapper component for form fields.

methods.name: LoadingField
methods.description: Displays a skeleton loader for loading filter fields.

methods.name: InlineError
methods.description: Displays an inline error message for filter options loading issues.

methods.name: StructuredSelect
methods.description: A dropdown select component with sorting and normalization.

methods.name: MultiSelectSkills
methods.description: A multi-select component for filtering skills with search support.

methods.name: Filters
methods.description: Main component rendering the collection of filter UI elements based on props.

methods.name: ActiveFilterTags
methods.description: Component rendering active filter tags with remove buttons and clear-all option.
